newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy files $300 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy files $300 mln shelf offer.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said Wednesday it has filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $300 million of new common stock and convertible preferred securities.
Included with the SEC filing is a prospectus supplement that would be used to issue three million CMS Energy convertible trust preferred securities for $150 million.
Proceeds would be used for general corporate purposes including repayment of debt, capital expenditures, investment in subsidiaries and working capital, the energy company said.
Underwriters are led by Goldman, Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co, and Morgan Stanley & Co.

CMS Energy has electric and natural gas utility operations, independent power production, natural gas pipelines and storage, oil and gas exploration and production, and energy marketing, services and trading.
